prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Controls Tutorial Screen: Insert a dedicated tutorial screen right before finishing onboarding to explicitly teach desktop pet shortcuts, drag actions, and hide options. (why: Multiple support emails (3 tickets) showed post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet on the desktop.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Pet Choice to Reduce Initial Friction: Reorder onboarding so users choose their pet friend first, delaying sign-in until after the emotional connection is established. (why: Sign-in dropoff is 72.9% early in the flow, and 8 users suffered post-sign-in pet reset confusion due to premature account association.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Visual Path Selection Screen Overhaul: Replace text-heavy path options with prominent visual choice cards contrasting instant adoption versus photo-based pet creation. (why: The choose_path step has high mean duration (514s) and 76.2% conversion; clearer visual choices will speed up decisions.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Shortcut Hint Carousel on Waiting Screen: Add an automated tip carousel on the generation waiting screen highlighting key controls while the pet model downloads. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user dropoff and post-onboarding feature confusion.)
4: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Clarity Guidance and Requirements Hint: Display explicit lighting and framing guidelines directly on the photo upload screen before processing. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted models due to suboptimal source photos.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Account Sync Protection Highlight: Update sign-in headline and body copy to stress cloud backup security and pet recovery guarantee. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing back into their account.)
6: [finish, layout] Spotlight Desktop Launch Celebration Screen: Switch home intro screen layout to spotlight mode with a celebratory animated pet welcoming the user to their desktop. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8%, and 3 users reported being unaware that the app had opened on their desktop.)
7: [finish, notification] System Tray Alert Prompt on Finish Screen: Enable desktop notification prompt options on home intro screen so users receive alerts when pet events trigger. (why: 3 emails reported desktop pet not showing or app not appearing, likely due to app minimizing to system tray unrecognized.)

scores.note: Adding a new tutorial screen introduces extra friction despite addressing pet control support tickets.
Delaying auth until after pet selection reduces initial sign-in dropoff and addresses account reset issues.
Visual cards reduce cognitive load on choose_path, which currently suffers from a high 514s mean duration.
Carousel entertains and educates users during long wait times (median 201s), reducing dropoff.
Adoption step has the highest dropoff (39.1%); photo hints directly fix generation failure complaints.
Copy change addresses 8 support emails regarding reset confusion at zero technical cost.
Spotlight layout makes desktop transition obvious, helping recover the 35.2% finish step dropoff.
System tray notification guidance prevents users from assuming the app crashed or disappeared.
